properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 14 at 9:11PM MST until September 14 at 11:30PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
North Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 1130 PM MST.

* At 911 PM MST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms had produced heavy rain in Brawley Wash at Manville
Road. Between 1.5 and 2.5 inches of rain have fallen.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Avra Valley, Saguaro National Park West and Picture Rocks.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Manville Rd at Brawley Wash and Twin Peaks Rd between Sanders and
Sandario.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 11:30 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 11:30 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 15 at 12:54AM CDT until September 15 at 2:00AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
SVROAX

The National Weather Service in Omaha has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northern Pottawattamie County in southwestern Iowa...
Southeastern Harrison County in southwestern Iowa...
Southern Shelby County in southwestern Iowa...

* Until 200 AM CDT.

* At 1254 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 4 miles south of
Missouri Valley, or 12 miles east of Blair, moving east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Neola, Minden, Persia, Shelby, Avoca and Walnut.

This includes Interstate 80 in Iowa between mile markers 20 and 48.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 14 at 9:23PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Tampa Bay Ruskin has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Florida...

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Horse Creek near Arcadia at SR 72.

* WHEN...From Wednesday morning until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The access road to Hidden Oak is
impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Monday the stage was 9.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
Wednesday morning and continue rising to 12.4 feet Thursday
evening. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 12.5
feet on 08/31/2002.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Tuesday afternoon at 200 PM EDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING IN EFFECT FROM WEDNESDAY MORNING UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 14 at 9:25PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Marion, Citrus and Levy
Counties.

.Elevated water levels are expected along the river over the next
several days due to recent heavy rainfall.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Withlacoochee at US 41 Dunnellon.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 28.2 feet, Docks and boat ramps flood along the river
in Citrus and Marion counties.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:45 PM EDT Monday the stage was 28.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 28.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage just
after midnight tonight and continue rising to 28.2 feet just
after midnight tonight. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 28.2 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 28.4
feet on 08/05/2024.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Tuesday afternoon at 200 PM EDT.
